digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure - CI workflow parity collection
propositions: Nested pytest collection subprocess launched without --basetemp shares the numbered temp root with parent, allowing session cleanup to delete or traverse sibling run temp trees.
A regression test poisoning the shared numbered temp root demonstrates pre-existing sentinel deletion before the fix.

_collect_node_ids must pass a caller-owned private --basetemp to nested pytest while preserving collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract (0/5), cwd, timeout (300s), and :: node parsing.
The fix uses TemporaryDirectory to own a private basetemp and provides it to nested pytest subprocess without changing caller signature or behavior.
Regression test passes GREEN after the fix and returns to RED when --basetemp arguments are removed, confirming the fix is necessary and sufficient.
